$comment: Painted basic lands (land styles in the cosmetics catalog with no set code): five cards per style, drawn in place of a player's basic lands in matches (ui/landStyles.ts). The name is printed by the client in the empty band at the top. Grids are two styles (rows) of five basics. After drawing, run `python3 art/fit_cards.py public/career-art/land/*.webp` to fit each card.
style: Basic land cards: one upright full-art land card per cell, front view, all the same 5:7 rectangle with slightly rounded corners and straight edges; nothing sticks out past the card's edge. The whole card is ONE flat solid field of the accent ink named by the subject (the land's colour, printed like a solid letterpress block, with its speckle), with a thin ivory border inset from the edge, and the subject's scene carved in ivory filling the card inside that border. Across the top, just inside the border, leave a plain empty name band about one ninth of the card's height: a thin ivory outline around a strip of plain accent ink with NOTHING inside it (no marks, no symbols, no letters). No other text anywhere. Each row of the grid is one style; keep the five cards of a row clearly one family. Each card fills about 90% of its cell's height.
spare: a land card in deep green-black accent ink with a thin ivory border and an empty name band
